description: This file defines the 'JobsAdapter' class, a RecyclerView adapter used in an Android application to display a list of jobs. It manages how job data is presented in the list and handles item click events to navigate to a detailed activity. It also includes a nested 'JobsHolder' class for managing individual list item views.

classes.name: JobsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of jobs, managing view creation and data binding.

classes.name: JobsHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for holding references to the views within each job list item and handling click events.

methods.name: JobsAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of jobs.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JobsHolder instance for each list item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds job data to the list item views for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of jobs in the list.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Checks if the input string is null or 'null' and replaces it with an empty string.

methods.name: JobsHolder
methods.description: Constructs the holder and initializes view references, setting up click handling.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on a list item to start the JobsActivityExtended with relevant data.
